content: A sum of decision trees in which each tree corrects the previous ones' errors (xgboost, 1 thread). rounds is the number of rounds, max_depth the depth of the trees, eta the learning rate. Shows the accuracy, the time, a breakdown of the mistakes and the test error rate by round, and passes predictions for every test image to compare.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Accuracy, CPU time, settings, and predictions for every test image
